name: dispatch_agent
description: Hand a coding task to an external coding agent (opencode, Claude Code, or Codex) running in this workstream's isolated git worktree. Use for real code changes: implementing a feature, fixing a bug, refactoring, or running and fixing tests. The agent reads and edits files itself and its progress streams back live. Returns a summary plus the resulting diff. Requires the workstream to be bound to a repo first (bind_repo). Prefer this over editing many files by hand.

task.description: The coding task, written as you would brief a competent engineer: what to change, where, and any constraints or acceptance criteria.

agent.description: Which agent CLI to use. Defaults to the server-configured agent, falling back to whichever is installed.

model.description: Optional model override passed to the agent (opencode expects 'provider/model'). Blank uses the agent's own default.

continue_session.description: Continue the previous dispatch in this workstream instead of starting fresh, so the agent keeps its context. Use for follow-up instructions on the same task.

timeout.description: Seconds before the agent run is aborted. Defaults to 1800.
